I submitted an equal-weighted portfolio of 50 signals. I picked them by training Sharpe among signals with a positive Sharpe in both halves of 1970-1999. It had a training Sharpe of about 1.55 and a validation Sharpe of about 0.22.

The edge looks weak. Nothing I tried gave a validation Sharpe above roughly 0.2. The other portfolios I tested scored 0.05 to 0.19 (or slightly negative) in validation, and the signals' training performance mostly did not carry into 2000-2012. I used only 14 of the 5000 backtests and did not tune on validation, so the 0.22 figure is not inflated by searching on it.
